bagPolicy.summary: Small purses and fanny packs up to 12” x 12” x 6” are allowed. Backpacks of any kind or size are prohibited.
allowed: Small purses and fanny packs up to 12” x 12” x 6
prohibited: Backpacks of any kind or size
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is ample paid parking available at Nashville Yards in multiple garages, including Nashville Yards, Pinnacle Tower, and Amazon Towers. The garages are gateless for easy entry/exit, and event parking rates vary by event.

rideshare.note: Rideshare is highly encouraged with drop off and pick up located on 9th Ave. N & Commerce St.

concessions.note: The Pinnacle offers a variety of food and drink options to enhance the concert experience. While specific vendors are not listed, the venue likely features local and popular concessions to cater to diverse tastes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Pinnacle, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Pinnacle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Pinnacle. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Pinnacle. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
